newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to decrease margins on cocoa futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to decrease margins on cocoa futures.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Wednesday it will lower margins on the September 1997 and December 1997 cocoa contracts by $200, to $600, including no spot charge, effective July 31.
The margin required on all other cocoa contracts will also be lowered by $200, to $600, the exchange said in a statement.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
